cohort: The cohort comprised 294 patients (32 with recurrent EP and 262 with primary EP) diagnosed with an ectopic pregnancy and treated with a single-dose regimen of intramuscular MTX in a tertiary medical centre between 2010 and 2018.
finding: Medical treatment success with a single-dose regimen of MTX was significantly lower in patients with recurrent ectopic pregnancy compared to those with primary ectopic pregnancy (40.6% vs. 66.4%).
